title: Contractor Lead Engine (California)
summary: Portfolio demo for agencies and SaaS selling to HVAC, plumbing, and electrical contractors: verified, sourced leads with human-ready outreach drafts.
problem: Outbound teams targeting licensed contractors need leads that are provably tied to public license data, scored with evidence, and safe to email—not scraped guesswork with unverified contacts.
solution: Self-built portfolio demo for automation and lead generation. Uses a real public subset of California CSLB license data (Alameda and Sacramento counties); every fact carries its source link; owner names are cross-checked against CSLB personnel. Company websites in the demo are synthetic; email verification runs in mock mode (production would plug in a real verification service). Leads are scored Hot/Warm/Cold with evidence, a personalized first line is drafted for human approval, and exports include only verified emails. Personal names are masked in the public demo. Demo funnel: 120 licenses → 93 → 58 hard ICP fit. Separately: 27 with an OK email; 28 Hot/Warm. 20 exportable leads (Hot 13, Warm 15, Cold 30).

zh.title: 承包商线索引擎（加州）
zh.summary: 给向暖通、水管、电工承包商销售的代理公司和 SaaS 用的作品集演示：线索有来源、经过核实，并起好可人工确认的开发信开场白。
zh.problem: 做承包商外呼的团队需要的线索，要能对上公开执照数据、打分有依据、邮箱能安全发出，而不是爬来的猜测和未核实联系方式。
zh.solution: 自建作品集演示。用加州 CSLB 执照数据的真实公开子集（阿拉米达和萨克拉门托县）；每条事实都带来源链接；业主姓名与 CSLB 人员记录交叉核对。演示里的公司网站是合成的；邮箱核实跑的是模拟模式（正式上线要接真实的核实服务）。线索按 Hot/Warm/Cold 打分并附依据，起好个性化开场白给人确认，导出只含已核实邮箱。公开演示里真人姓名已遮挡。演示漏斗：120 份执照 → 93 → 58 个符合硬性客户画像。另外：27 个邮箱可用；28 个 Hot/Warm。20 条可导出线索（Hot 13、Warm 15、Cold 30）。
